name: Dual-System Smith Flat Bench Press
instructions: Set the Dual-System Power Smith Machine's integrated bench to the flat, horizontal position using the adjustment lever.
Load the desired weight plates onto the dual plate horns on each side of the machine.
Lie flat on the bench with your chest aligned directly underneath the dual independent press handles.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, rotate to release the safety catches, and start with your arms extended.
Lower the handles smoothly toward your mid chest under control, feeling a deep stretch across the pectorals.
Press the handles back up firmly by contracting your chest until your arms are extended, then re-engage the safety catch when the set is complete.
